You don't just move boxes; you manage the integrity of international trade by ensuring all cargo is cleared, secured, and palletized according to strict aviation standards. You operate with a deep understanding of the logistical flow and are capable of making split-second decisions to prevent delays in global transport.
 Tasks
  Orchestrating the full handling cycle of air freight shipments under strict deadlines.
 Verifying and managing complex airway bills, customs declarations, and manifests.
 Supervising the technical build-up of ULDs to maximize flight capacity and safety.
